desktop.notes:
• Fullscreen starts with the photo filling the whole screen (no edge line; the edges of the photo may be cut).
• 0 = the whole photo with black bands; 0 again = fill. 1 = 100 %, 2 = 200 % as before.
• The status icon is at the bottom left; with I info open it sits in the info box.
